12-month savings shows how much money you could save over a full year by choosing a 12-month commitment when compared between plans. Because the monthly price is lower with a yearly commitment, the savings represent the total difference you would pay with each plan. Close - -

Multi-gym Access

Bring a guest 4 times a month
Bring a guest up to 4 times a month
Plus members can visit their home gym with a nominated friend at no extra cost up to 4 times per month. Friends can only visit the gym at the same time as the Plus member. Close No Yes
Freeze your membership any time
Freeze your membership any time
Off-peak and Core members can freeze their membership for up to 3 months from £6.99. Plus members can freeze their membership at no additional cost for up to 3 months in a 12-month period. Close No Yes
Unlimited flavoured water with vitamins*
Unlimited flavoured water with vitamins*
Filtered, chilled, sugar-free, and packed with vitamins, our Sports Water comes in 6 fruity flavours. Plus members can refill their bottle with unlimited servings—better for you and the environment. Core and Off-Peak members get one free vend to try it out!

About PureGym Harold Wood
No matter what your fitness goal may be, you'll find everything you need at PureGym Harold Wood. Take your pick from the latest gym kit and a huge timetable of group exercise classes included in your membership. Want access to state-of-the-art gym equipment with a low-cost monthly payment (with no contract)? Our 24/7 gym in Harold Wood is fitted with a huge range of equipment, including free weights, fixed resistance machines, and cardio equipment.
We’re located on the Southend Arterial Road, near Jollyes, Toyota Romford and McDonald's. You can park on site for free in PureGym’s dedicated on-site car park!*
We want to keep PureGym a safe environment for everyone to work out. If you plan to train at night or during unstaffed hours, please read our unstaffed hours document to ensure your safety when at the gym.
Made for how you move
Whether you’re chasing a PB or just feeling good in your body, our equipment is here to help you train your way.
360 virtual tour of Harold Wood Gym View 360 tour
Unlimited classes. Unlimited you. Find your flow, from high energy to low impact, every class is included at most gyms – and there’s something for every fitness mood and every kind of mover. View Classes

Getting to PureGym
Driving
Pop RM3 0BZ into your SatNav and navigate to the gym, where you can park in PureGym’s dedicated on-site car park for free !*
*Parking restrictions may apply. Please check in the car park before you enter the gym. PureGym is not responsible for any parking fines.
